ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 5:95 ratio of high-intensity (white/barnacle) pixels to low-intensity (black/pigment) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (dark) pigmentation across the central and medial regions; high-contrast white circular pixel clusters are mapped exclusively to the lateral tips of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression at approximately 65 degrees; depth of notch is significant, splitting the fluke into two distinct, asymmetrical lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge; the right lobe shows deeper, more jagged indentations compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe follows a relatively straight to slightly concave sweep towards the tip; the right lobe exhibits a more pronounced convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast white circular clusters localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe irregular serration and apparent tissue loss along the trailing edge, particularly on the right lobe lobe, indicating significant physical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct 'fringe' effect at the fluke tips caused by localized calcified organism accumulation.
